title: Polynomial-time computability of the reduction output
statement: Fix a Boolean circuit encoding and an output-sensitive PCPP reduction, and suppose its generated proof lengths are bounded by a polynomial in circuit size. Then the reduction’s total output function on binary strings is computed by a single-tape Turing machine in polynomial time.
hypotheses_covered: An output-sensitive PCPP reduction for that encoding
A polynomial bound on generated proof lengths in circuit size
